requirements.text: • Experience: 3–6 years of experience focusing on MLOps, machine learning engineering, or AI model deployment.
• Platform Expertise: Hands-on experience with platforms like Dataiku or Databricks for building and managing ML workflows.
• Technical Skills: Strong programming background in Python, familiarity with SQL, and experience with containerization/CI-CD pipelines for AI models.
• Collaboration: Strong communication skills with an ability to work collaboratively in fast-paced, cross-functional tech teams.
